main_text.p: Figura vocis est qua disquiritur utrū vox simplex, an composita sit. Simplex: ut Doctus, gelehrt/amo, ich liebe. Composita: ut, perdoctus, wolgelehrt/ redamo, ich liebe widerumb.

Vox numeri est, quæ numerum adsignificat. Die stim der zal ist/ so einen zaal neben andeutet. Numerus est duplex: Singularis, aut Pluralis. Singularis numerus est, quo res singularis exprimi potest: ut, Doctus, Legit. Pluralis, quo res plures exprimi possunt: ut, Docti, Legunt.
Duæ: Nomen & Verbum, zwo: der name und das wort.
main_text.head: DE NOMINE.
main_text.p: Nomen est vox numeri cum genere, casu & declinatione. Der name ist ein stim der zal mit dem geschlechte/ falle und der biegung.
Duplex: Substantivum aut Adjectivum. zweyfältig: der bestehende oder zugewoertene.

Cujus significatio per se absq; altero addito intelligitur. welchers bedeutung ohn anderem zugethan verstanden wirdt: ut Homo, ein Mensch/ Equus, ein Pferd. Substantivum est aut Appellativum, aut Proprium. Appellativum, quod multis commune est, der gemeine name ist/ welcher vielen gemein ist: ut, urbs,

page.notes: The German glosses are in black letter and were read from a small scan. "zal" and "zaal" are printed with a long-tailed z, shown here as z. Spellings such as "zwo", "widerumb" and "zweyfältig" are as printed. The word after "gelehrt/" is partly obscured and may be "amo" or a similar form. The large "D" of "Die" and "N" of "Nomen" are decorated initials, joined to their words. The rule between the sections is a printer's ornament and is not transcribed.
